newsitem.title: USA: First Bancshares Inc Q3 March 31 net up.
newsitem.headline: First Bancshares Inc Q3 March 31 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Included in 1997 nine month net income are $119,000, after tax, of gains from sales of investments; a $16,000 loss on the writedown of property and a $370,000 after-tax one-time SAIF assessment. Excluding these items, net income would have been $1.3 million.

During the 1996 Q3, four investment securities were liquidated at a gain of $24,000; one loan, purchased at a discount, prepaid for a $9,000 profit and a rental property was sold at a $17,000 gain. Loan loss reserves were increased during the Q3 by $47,000 for underperforming loan pools purchased and by $40,000 for an overdraft on a commercial account. Included in the 1996 nine month net income were $59,000 of nonrecurring, after-tax expenses.
